description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Rubicante)], [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Rubicante)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Magical Blink 1], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Rubicante)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Rubicante)] from the user

description.name: Magical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Rubicante)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Fire abilities

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
